query: As of July 13 2026, what is the current status of the Eastern Pacific hurricane season? Are there any active tropical storms or disturbances being monitored by NHC that could become named storm Elida (5th storm) or later? List all named EPAC storms of 2026 so far with formation dates, and any current NHC tropical weather outlook areas of interest east of 140W.
answer:
I've completed the research on the 2026 Eastern Pacific hurricane season status as of July 13–14, 2026. Here's the summary:

**Four named storms had formed so far:**
- **Amanda** (June 2–3), **Boris** (June 7), **Cristina** (June 8), and **Douglas** (July 1)

**Path to storm #5 (Elida):** Yes — **Tropical Depression Five-E** formed July 14, 2026 (NHC Advisory #1 at 21:00 UTC, from Invest 96E), located ~14.8°N, 109.2°W several hundred miles SW of Mexico. NHC forecast it to become **Tropical Storm Elida** within ~12–24 hours and possibly a hurricane (~85 kt/100 mph) by ~July 17, with rapid intensification flagged as possible. It's forecast to stay well offshore. Mexico's SMN confirmed "Cinco-E" would be named Elida.

**NHC TWO areas of interest east of 140°W:** One area — offshore of southern/southwestern Mexico — with a **70% (high) 7-day formation chance**, the likely candidate for storm #6 (Fausto). Two other monitored areas (near Hawaii) are west of 140°W and thus in the Central Pacific.

The season is running slightly ahead of climatology (the 5th EPAC storm typically forms around July 23), driven by warm SSTs tied to a strengthening El Niño.

key_facts: The 2026 Eastern Pacific hurricane season began May 15, 2026 and had an active, above-climatology start supported by a strengthening El Nino.
Four EPAC named storms had formed as of the reference date: Amanda (formed June 2-3), Boris (June 7), Cristina (June 8), and Douglas (July 1, 2026).
Tropical Storm Amanda was the first named storm, forming as TD One-E and becoming a tropical storm on June 3, 2026 (15:00 UTC), WSW of Baja California.
Tropical Storm Douglas, the 4th named storm, formed July 1, 2026 at 21:00 UTC well WSW of southern Baja California and weakened to a remnant low by ~July 3; no land threat.
Tropical Depression Five-E (EP052026) formed July 14, 2026 (Advisory #1 at 21:00 UTC / 2 PM MST) from Invest 96E, positioned ~14.8N, 109.2W several hundred miles SW of southwestern Mexico.

TD Five-E is the direct precursor to the 5th named storm, Elida; NHC forecast it to reach tropical storm strength within ~12-24 hours and hurricane strength (~85 kt/100 mph) by ~July 17, with rapid intensification possible per SHIPS.

Mexico's Servicio Meteorologico Nacional (SMN) confirmed that TD 'Cinco-E' would be named Elida upon reaching tropical storm strength; it is forecast to remain well offshore of Mexico with no direct land strike.
NHC's July 14 TWO flagged an area offshore of southern/southwestern Mexico (east of 140W) with a 7-day formation chance of 70% (high) — candidate for the 6th named storm, Fausto.
Two additional monitored areas lie in the Central Pacific west of 140W: Well South of Hawaii (CP91, 7-day 40%) and Well Southwest of Hawaii (CP90, 7-day 60%).
The climatological average formation date for the 5th EPAC named storm is around July 23, so Elida forming in mid-July is slightly ahead of average pace.
